author: KEXP
description: Back in December, our remote crew headed back to Rennes, France to record fifteen new live sessions with artists from all over the world. Dive into the depths of music discovery and subscribe to our listener-powered YouTube channel to get notified when new sessions from Trans Musicales begin to drop.
title: Launching Wednesday, January 13th: Gaia Banfi Live on KEXP from Trans Musicales
